semiconductor_relevance: High — ICSPI Corp provides advanced atomic force microscope systems crucial for semiconductor inspection and metrology.
summary: ICSPI Corp develops and manufactures high-throughput atomic force microscope (AFM) systems using their patented microAFM technology. Their systems are designed to enhance the speed and precision of inline metrology and inspection processes, particularly in advanced packaging applications such as hybrid bonding.
capabilities: microAFM technology on a 1 mm² chip
Parallel arrays for enhanced speed in metrology
Fast multiAFM systems for advanced packaging
